weapons.title: Лунная Охота
weapons.silhouette: silver crescent mark, focused bolt, and four split bolts
weapons.motion_path: mark bloom, aimed bolt, then four diagonal split bolts
weapons.impact_language: moon-mark flash followed by a four-way silver split
weapons.timing_rhythm: 0.70 s mark ceremony under a swelling night veil, the aimed bolt lands at 1.05 s with a 95 ms hitstop, four split bolts hold the arena to 2.60 s, then the veil lifts

performance.v2_budget_note: FAN-3736: five split-bolt elements plus the backdrop veil and the hero cast pose; the veil gradient is the only full-screen surface and no CanvasItem material is authored

quality.reduced_motion_substitute: with ultimate_reduced_motion on (the persisted ultimate_accessibility_settings preference, read by the scene driver itself; the shipped screen_shake toggle also holds it) the timeline scene applies no camera shake, so the moon mark bloom, the aimed bolt and the four split bolts carry the beat on their own on the unchanged timing; the backdrop veil still swells to 0.30 and the 95 ms hitstop still freezes the drawn pose on the first impact
quality.measurement: FAN-3941 real-runtime certification capture: peak authored-scene opaque coverage 0.0041 of the viewport (alpha >= 0.5 on a paused scene-only render of the live cast started through UltimatePlayerHost, stride 2; the 1152x648 normal cast is swept every frame at 60 fixed fps and every committed frame is measured); the arena-wide veil is a translucent darken tint peaking at 0.30 that rises once per cast and is excluded from opaque coverage; it is layered at absolute z 2, above the arena floor and the actors but below every enemy hazard telegraph (z 6-9) and enemy projectile (z 12), so telegraphs and bolts keep their native contrast under it; with ultimate_photosensitivity_safe on the driver never lights it; the live cast moves the Player camera on the first impact with the preferences off and 0 px with ultimate_reduced_motion on (per-frame traces in the capture manifest)

live_capture.note: Twelve live panels per sheet: three canonical weapons by four presentation modes, each rendered from its shipped scene at a fixed beat. `crowded` draws the declared crowd cap, `reduced_motion` renders with the shipped screen_shake toggle off, and `photosensitivity_safe` suppresses the arena-wide backdrop veil at capture time. No production scene, VFX, gameplay or balance value is changed.

certification.note: Real-runtime captures: one cast per weapon x mode x viewport through UltimatePlayerHost with the shipped Player (own current Camera2D), real Enemy scenes, a real hazard telegraph and enemy projectile, and the live ultimate HUD adapter, under a fixed 60 fps clock and the exclusive process admission, with the reduced-motion and photosensitivity-safe modes published through the production ultimate_accessibility_settings snapshot; the active beat and every payoff beat at every viewport plus release/impact/recovery at 1152x648. The capture manifest pins every file hash, the engine, the command, per-frame camera/world state, the measured coverage and the per-run camera-offset traces behind the mode effects.
